messages:
Maya (People Ops): thanks everyone who joined the all-hands — starting this thread for quick follow-up q's on reviews/leveling/comp 🙂
Jamal (PM): quick one — how much do peer reviews actually factor into promo decisions?
Maya (People Ops): good Q. peer feedback is one of three signals: manager calibration, peer feedback, and cross-functional impact examples. weighting is roughly 40% manager, 30% peer/skip-level, 30% impact evidence, but it isn't a hard formula.
Devon (Eng): if i had an accelerated roadmap delivery, where should i submit the evidence? docs or a follow-up email?
Maya (People Ops): put it in the promotion packet template (link: https://intranet.redwood/proc/promo-packet) and ping your manager to add it to the calibration packet.
Sarah (IC): clarification on retroactive comp — is there any chance for backdated increases for promo effective dates?
Lea (CEO): short answer: usually we avoid retroactive cash payouts for past months. we can make the promo effective at start of next pay period; exceptional cases are rare — speak to Maya and finance with a concrete case.
Jamal (PM): timeline Q — when will people know decisions after calibration?
Maya (People Ops): calibration completes mid-week, final HR emails go out within 7 business days after calibration. managers should have 1:1 talking points prepared within 48 hours of the notice.
Devon (Eng): about leveling ladders — any changes coming for IC4 vs IC5 expectations?
Maya (People Ops): we're revising a couple of role examples to clarify cross-team ownership and mentoring expectations. draft will be posted in the careers/levels doc next Tue for comment.
Sarah (IC): benefits Q: is parental leave policy changing this year?
HR Bot: Policy update posted: https://intranet.redwood/benefits/2026-parental-update — core leave unchanged, new top-up for primary caregivers added for eligible tenure >12 months.
Maya (People Ops): action item — i'll host two office hours this week (Thu 11am, Fri 4pm) to go over packet questions. drop a time in this thread if you need a private slot.
Jamal (PM): can we get a short FAQ that distills the main promo dos/don'ts for managers? managers are getting flooded.
Maya (People Ops): yes — i'll publish a one-pager and a manager checklist by EOD Friday.
Devon (Eng): will calibration matrices be viewable by managers post-process?
Maya (People Ops): managers will see only their team-level outcomes and anonymized cross-team notes; full raw comments remain confidential.
Lea (CEO): appreciate all the questions — a reminder that promotions are about growth & impact, not just tenure. we'll keep iterating the process to make it clearer.
Sarah (IC): thanks — i'll sign up for Thu office hours.
Maya (People Ops): noted — @Sarah (IC) confirmed. If others want private review help, DM me or use /book-hr slot. end of thread.
